bio.zh: 中央資管碩士生，專長 AI 模型架構與應用開發。曾與工研院合作處理資料稀少與類別不平衡問題，也參與過兆豐金控產學合作，研究隨機優勢的可預測性與持續性。
bio.en: M.S. student at NCU Information Management, focused on AI model architecture and application development. He worked with ITRI on data scarcity and class imbalance, and worked on an industry-academia project with Mega Financial Holding on the predictability and persistence of stochastic dominance.
